reasonForFutureBarrier: The start barrier is deliberately later than the freeze commit so the rule family is public in Git history before any eligible outcome can enter the prospective sample.
objective: Test whether a fully preregistered family of 3-number or 4-number selectors can predict the roulette winning number above the uniform k/37 null on genuinely future rounds, independently of the Lightning timing hypothesis.

phaseA.name: PROSPECTIVE_SELECTION
phaseA.purpose: Choose exactly one selector for each coverage using only the first 5000 eligible future rounds.
phaseA.selectionMetric: highest hitExcess versus k/37; tie-break by lower exact one-sided binomial p, then lower lookback, then lexicographic mode

phaseB.name: PROSPECTIVE_CONFIRMATION
phaseB.selectors: the two deterministic phase-A winners only; no retuning

economicReporting.reason: Rare Lightning multipliers can dominate realized P&L; the primary number-selection claim is winner prediction above the uniform null.

readPolicy.after10000: V1_RESULT_IMMUTABLE; LATER DATA CANNOT RESCUE A FAIL
